umzug.intro: Your save game stays on this device — this only relinks your online account (friends & co.).
umzug.erklaerung: On the OLD device (or in the server panel) a move code is created. Enter it here: friend code, friends list and GoobyPal history will then belong to this device.
umzug.warnung_alt: The old device will be signed out online.
umzug.erfolg: Done! Your online account now lives here — friend code: {code}
umzug.fehler_kurz: The code has 8 characters — please double-check.
umzug.fehler_code: The server does not know this code (already used or a typo?).
umzug.fehler_abgelaufen: The code has expired — move codes are valid for 24 hours. Please create a new one.
umzug.fehler_offline: Offline right now — moving needs a connection to the server.
